newExternalAssets.name: periwinkle_plant
newExternalAssets.author: Amal Kumar
newExternalAssets.adaptation: Existing frozen original mesh geometry and PBR maps; world transforms baked, root datum normalized, uniformly scaled, instanced on raycast dry terrain. No global asset changes.

existingAssets: Existing scene-local generated mineral/wood/clay material guides and declared CC0 granite/moss-rock scans are retained. Global scan files are unchanged.

geometry.toro: Narrower source-led hero proportions, closed tapered octagonal shafts with incised vine relief, smaller carved base/frieze courses, deeper roof bearing bosses, independently weathered rounded roofs, bulky worn finials, clipped surface-rooted moss and finer actual window grids.
geometry.portal: Three nested open frames, closed side reveals, gilt carved lining, fifteen real coffer panels, thirteen chain drops and two supported visible oil lamps.
geometry.ceramic: Separate closed concave pan and convex cover tiles. Smooth analytical ceramic normals and consistent front-face winding replace faceted half-pipe normals.
geometry.paving: Retains independently observed slab outlines/solids. Authored 5.77mm-pitch mineral field is restored to 85 percent of its declared metric relief, approximately -0.64 to +1.01mm, rather than 15 percent.
geometry.understory: Actual original licensed multi-leaf/stem mesh geometry and original PBR surface maps. Each plant retains uniform scale and all original mesh triangles. No whole-plant billboard, scene photograph, scene plate, depth substitute or reference RGB is rendered. Root positions are raycast against actual dry ground after garden warping. Water, stair/curb reserve, toro foot reserve and actual stone intersections are rejected. Roots are buried 12mm in support.
geometry.stair: Independent closed full-riser granite blocks with staggered joints, a 7.5mm worn bevel and real shallow mineral relief. The stair plan declares the same full-riser block thickness. Hidden support cores continue below; the old deeply chipped outline extrusion that corrugated entire riser faces is removed.
geometry.banks: Two closed irregular causeway bank solids replace long straight boxes. Their undulating outer margins and slightly sloped soil tops remain above the pond water and connect to the dry causeway/lantern islands. Plants are grounded only after the final bank deformation.

materialAndLight: Active scanned granite paving receives a brighter neutral mineral pigment and less exaggerated normal slope. Toro and stair surfaces retain CC0 metric scan mineral variation with world-coherent damp weathering. Cap and finial are separately aged, with physically clipped moss. Deep carved relief and subtly eroded closed caps are actual geometry. Sun, camera and dolly are unchanged.
dependencyIsolation: Exact baseline c6841ad stone loader is vendored into the Scene04 source namespace; no Scene01 source code is imported at runtime. Its provenance is separately recorded.
limits: All new forms, hidden depths and material settings remain authored reconstruction hypotheses. Native render diagnostics do not establish photographic fidelity or structural certification.
